## تماس ویدیویی HD چیست و چه مشکلی را حل:
## What HD video calls are and the problems they solve

Some customer questions cannot be answered with text alone: completing a complicated form, seeing a physical product or receiving advice that needs a visual explanation. Webyar HD video calls let operators start a high-quality video conversation without leaving the chat window.

## No app installation for customers

Unlike conferencing tools that require a separate link or software installation, Webyar video calls run in the same chat window on your website. The customer clicks a button to start. This simplicity makes it easier for customers to accept a video call.

## HD quality on limited connections

Webyar's video infrastructure adjusts picture quality to the customer's connection speed, helping calls stay connected on slower networks. This is particularly useful for businesses serving customers in different locations with varying internet quality.

## Screen sharing for clearer guidance

Operators can share their screens during a video call to guide customers through a form or demonstrate a report. Calls can also be recorded and archived for later review.

## Common uses

HD video calls support sales consultations, product demonstrations, complex technical support, virtual property tours and introductory healthcare consultations. Seeing one another can increase trust and clarity, and often improves conversion compared with text chat alone.

## ارتباط چندکاناله یعنی چه؟ امروز مشتری:
## What omnichannel communication means

Customers do not only message through your website. Some contact you on WhatsApp, others on Telegram or Instagram. When these messages are scattered across separate tools, replies can be delayed or missed. Webyar brings them into a single inbox.

## Why centralized messaging matters

Switching between apps takes time and makes messages easier to overlook. Bringing WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram into Webyar lets operators see every active conversation and respond without confusion.

## Connecting WhatsApp Business, Telegram and Instagram

Connect channels through the dashboard settings. Incoming messages then join the shared operator queue just like live website chats, and can be assigned to the operator who previously spoke with that customer.

## Reports for each channel

Webyar reports show the share of messages from each channel, response times and conversion rates. Use this information to focus your support resources on the channels that bring results.

## Who benefits

Online stores accepting orders through WhatsApp and Instagram, and businesses whose audiences use Telegram, can particularly benefit from Webyar's omnichannel tools.

## دستیار هوش مصنوعی وب‌یار چه کاری انجا:
## What the Webyar AI assistant does

Many customer questions repeat: business hours, delivery, returns or getting started. Webyar's AI assistant learns from your business knowledge base and can answer these questions accurately in seconds, without an operator.

## Automated answers without sacrificing quality

Unlike older chatbots limited to predefined keywords, Webyar's assistant uses your actual website, documentation and articles to produce natural, relevant Persian responses. In practice, more than 40% of conversations can be completed without operator intervention.

## Smart handoff for complex requests

When a question is outside the knowledge base or requires human judgment, such as a discount request or a sensitive complaint, the conversation and its full history are passed to a real operator. Customers do not have to repeat their questions.

## Building the assistant's knowledge base

Add articles, FAQs and product documentation through the dashboard. Keeping these sources complete and up to date improves the accuracy of the assistant's answers.

## The result for your support team

Handling repetitive questions automatically gives operators more time for complex, valuable conversations, helping improve customer satisfaction and reduce support costs.

## اتوماسیون و کمپین در وب‌یار چیست خیلی:
## Automation and campaigns in Webyar

Sales opportunities are often missed because nobody contacts the customer at the right time. Webyar lets you define simple rules that send the right message at the right moment, without an operator doing it manually.

## Personalized welcome messages

Show an appropriate message when a new visitor reaches a specific page or spends time on your pricing page. Timely interaction can encourage more visitors to start a conversation.

## Automatic follow-up for inactive leads

Customers who spoke to you but did not buy are easily forgotten. Define a rule to send a reminder after several days without a reply and reactivate these leads.

## Targeted email and SMS campaigns

In addition to chat messages, Webyar supports email and SMS campaigns scheduled around audience segments and behavior. Dashboard reports show open and conversion rates for each campaign.

## Why small teams benefit

Teams with fewer operators can gain especially from automation. Repetitive tasks such as reminders and welcome messages are handled automatically, leaving operators free to focus on real conversations.

## CRM و مدیریت مشتریان در وب‌یار چگونه:
## How Webyar CRM and customer management work

Customer interactions through chat, video calls and social channels should be kept together, rather than scattered across operators' memories. Webyar creates a complete profile for each contact, combining website visits, conversations and contact details.

## A complete customer view

From the first message, a visitor's profile includes pages viewed, previous conversations and any contact information they provide. Every operator can immediately understand the customer's previous interactions.

## Tags and audience segments

Tag contacts by customer type, sales stage or interests. These segments help sales and marketing teams understand audiences and run more targeted campaigns.

## Internal notes and follow-up

Operators can add team-only notes, such as a reminder that a customer is waiting for a quote or should be contacted again in a few days.

## Why an integrated CRM helps

Businesses using separate chat and CRM tools often transfer information manually. Webyar builds customer records alongside conversations, helping keep information together and ensuring sales teams can access the latest details.

## گزارش‌ها و تحلیل‌های پیشرفته چه چیزی:
## What advanced reports and analytics show

Without reliable data, decisions about staffing, response quality and campaign results are largely guesses. Webyar shows support and sales team performance in clear dashboards.

## Average response time per operator

See how long each operator takes to reply and how many conversations they handle at once. Managers can use these figures to distribute work fairly and identify staffing needs.

## Customer satisfaction

Collect simple feedback after each conversation. Track satisfaction over time and compare changes with team or support process updates.

## Conversation volume over time

## What live chat is and why online businesses need it

Most website visitors have at least one question before buying or signing up. Without a prompt answer, many leave and do not return. Webyar fills this gap with a lightweight widget on your website, letting customers speak with your team without leaving the page.

## Why live chat helps alongside email and phone support

Emails may take hours to answer, and many customers prefer not to make phone calls. Live chat combines speed and convenience: visitors can browse products while asking questions and receiving answers in seconds. Resolving doubts at the moment of decision can directly improve conversion.

## How Webyar live chat works

Install a line of code before your website's closing `</body>` tag, without changing the site structure. Visitor messages appear immediately in the Webyar web, mobile or desktop dashboard. Operators can send files, images and emoji. When several operators are online, new conversations can be distributed automatically.

## Complete customer history

When a visitor returns, operators can see earlier conversations without asking the customer to repeat their story. This is especially useful for stores and service businesses with repeat customers.

## When to use live chat

If your site sells products or services, has a pricing page or receives contact enquiries, live chat can help improve conversion and response times. Businesses replacing email-only support with Webyar have reported faster responses and better customer satisfaction.
